name: vale
description: Markup-aware prose linter that enforces custom writing-style rules from YAML style packages

vale.description: Configurable prose linter for banned words, punctuation, and AI-tell rules defined in YAML styles
vale.usage:
vale readme.txt                 # lint a file against .vale.ini styles
vale doc/                       # lint every supported file in a folder
vale --output=line file.md      # compact one-line-per-alert output
vale --no-exit sync             # download configured external styles
vale ls-config                  # print the resolved configuration
